# HopeFairy

> HopeFairy is an abroad admission advisory and career counselling consultancy for students in India and the GCC: 1-on-1 university admissions (UK, USA, Canada, Germany, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, France), India college admissions, SOP/LOR guidance, student visa support and test preparation (IMAT, SAT, IELTS, CELPIP).

## Main pages

- [Home](https://myhopefairy.com/): Overview of HopeFairy's study-abroad and counselling services
- [About Us](https://myhopefairy.com/about-us): Who we are and how we guide students
- [Services](https://myhopefairy.com/services): All advisory services in one place
- [Destinations](https://myhopefairy.com/destinations): Study destinations with tuition, living costs and intakes
- [India Admissions](https://myhopefairy.com/india-admissions): Admission guidance for India's top colleges
- [Gulf Desk](https://myhopefairy.com/gulf-desk): Dedicated desk for families in the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain
- [Test Prep](https://myhopefairy.com/test-prep): IMAT, SAT, IELTS and CELPIP preparation
- [Contact Us](https://myhopefairy.com/contact-us): Book a free counselling session
